subject: Future Tech
title: Who Governs Space Colonies?
description: One-minute skill: Who Governs Space Colonies?.

hook.text: The Outer Space Treaty of 1967 says no nation can claim territory in space. But what about a private colony on Mars?

buildup.text: If SpaceX builds a Martian city, it's unclear which country's laws apply. Musk has suggested direct democracy for Mars.

discovery.text: Historically, distant colonies always drifted from the motherland's control. Mars colonists would face the same pull.

twist.text: With a 20-minute communication delay, Earth-based governments can't manage Martian crises in real time.

climax.text: Legal scholars are already drafting space governance frameworks.

punchline.text: The first off-world government is a legal blank page.

quiz.question: What does the 1967 Outer Space Treaty say about territory claims?
options: No nation can claim space territory
Only the UN can claim territory
